summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares. On 8 June 2026, it purchased 10,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs at a volume-weighted average price of 99.4114 pence per share, as part of its existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares will be cancelled. The programme is an ordinary-course open-market repurchase under the Market Abuse Regulation. This is a routine capital return event with no special-situation catalyst or negotiation; what to watch is the programme's cumulative progress against its announced size.
